title: Scaling up Maternal Health Equity Best Practices
official: Scale-up Implementation Approaches to Ending Pregnancy-related and -Associated Morbidity and Mortality (MIRACLE Center Project 3)
summary: This study works with prenatal and postnatal care providers in 12 Michigan counties to scale up best practices for maternal health equity.
criteria:
Provider Inclusion Criteria:

-Be a provider or staff person at agencies offering prenatal and/or postnatal services in Wayne, Oakland, Ingham, Isabella, Macomb, Muskegon, Calhoun, Jackson, Saginaw, Kalamazoo, Barrien, or Washtenaw counties in Michigan.

Provider Exclusion Criteria:

* None

Patient outcomes are assessed through population-level Medicaid data, without direct recruitment.

Patient Inclusion criteria:

-All pregnant or postpartum (up to 12 months) people receiving Medicaid in Michigan

Patient Exclusion criteria:

-None

sites.f: Michigan State University on behalf on 12 Michigan counties
